interpretation.consistency_across_artifa.detail: No judge was run. The report, answer, code and computed arrays agree about fitted/validation/production procedures, the constant standardized-slope comparator, selection, units and actual MSSS.

interpretation.generalization.detail: No judge was run. Describe this as specified cyclic standardized-slope method adaptation using final-vintage prior-month observed SST and regional CHIRPS. Do not claim original CanSIPS paper replication, operational availability at historical issue time, or unseen2020–2023 outcome gains. Negative deterministic predictions are permitted by the method.

interpretation.statistical_support.detail: No judge was run. Any uncertainty or significance claim treats paired whole years as blocks; the36month-region cases within a year are not independent replications. Silence about inferential claims passes.
